scope.description: Bounded functional offertory constituent within the native running head Ordo Missæ: from red Deinde osculatur Altare, & versus ad populum after the Creed on printed p. 172, through the complete Secreta/preface-transition rubric ending signum Crucis sibi producit à fronte ad pectus on p. 174, above the horizontal rule and ¶ Sequens Præfatio. Includes every intervening prayer, dialogue, black quoted incipit, sign and red rubric. This functional bound is not a printed native chapter heading. No earlier Creed or later preface belongs to the constituent.
omitted_book_divisions: All front matter, calendar and general rubrics outside this bounded Ordo Missæ constituent
Earlier Ordo Missæ, including the Creed and its chant before the opening Deinde osculatur Altare on printed p. 172
All prefaces beginning with ¶ Sequens Præfatio below the rule on printed p. 174, the Canon and remaining Ordo Missæ
The entire Temporale, Sanctorale, Commons, votive and other proper formularies, lectionary and chant outside the declared constituent

Colour changes of display initials are not encoded as separate letters; line-class metadata identifies red rubrics, response cue, black spoken incipits and inline red alternatives/crosses. sources.publication: Parisiis, Sumptibus Sebastiani Cramoisy et Gabrielis Cramoisy, 1657
sources.title: Missale Cisterciense iuxta Romani recogniti correctionem. Primo editum. Authoritate Superiorum

title: Cistercian missal 1657: complete bounded offertory constituent

units.source_locator: Printed p. 172, right column, after the Creed through quam offerens, dicit. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 1.
units.text:
Deinde osculatur Altare, & versus ad populum, dicit ℣.
Dóminus vobíscum.
℟.
Et cum spíritu tuo.
Posteà dicit,
Orémus.
& Offertorium. Quo dicto, si est Missa solemnis, Diaconus porrigit Celebranti patenam cum Hostia: si priuata, Sacerdos ipse accipit patenam cum Hostia, quam offerens, dicit.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 172, right column bottom, continuing p. 173, left column top. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 1,2.
units.text: Súscipe sancte pater, omnípotens ætérne Deus, hanc immaculátam hóstiam, quam ego indígnus fámulus tuus óffero tibi Deo meo viuo & vero, pro innumerabílibus peccátis & offensiónibus & negligéntiis meis, & pro ómnibus circumstántibus, sed & pro ómnibus fidélibus Christiánis viuis atque defúnctis: vt mihi & illis profíciat ad salútem in vitam ætérnam. Amen.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, left column, after Suscipe sancte pater. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Deinde faciens crucem cum eadem patena, deponit Hostiam super corporale. Diaconus ministrat vinum, Subdiaconus aquam in Calice: vel si priuata est Missa, vtrumque infundit Sacerdos, & aquam miscendam in Calice benedicit, ✠ dicens:

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, left column. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Déus, qui humánæ substántiæ dignitátem mirabíliter condidísti, & mirabílius reformásti: da nobis per huius aquæ & vini mystérium, eius diuinitátis esse consórtes, qui humanitátis nostræ fíeri dignátus est párticeps, Iesus Christus fílius tuus Dóminus noster: Qui tecum viuit & regnat in vnitáte Spíritus sancti Deus: per ómnia sæcula sæculórum, Amen.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, left column, after Deus qui humanae. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: In Missis pro Defunctis dicitur prædicta Oratio: sed aqua non benedicitur. Posteà accipit Calicem, & offert, dicens:

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, left column. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Offérimus tibi Dómine cálicem salutáris, tuam deprecántes cleméntiam: vt in conspéctu diuinæ maiestátis tuæ, pro nostra & totíus mundi salúte cum odóre suauitátis ascéndat. Amen.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, left column, below Offerimus tibi. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Deinde facit signum crucis cum Calice, & illum ponit super corporale, & palla cooperit: tum iunctis manibus super Altare, aliquantulùm inclinatus dicit:

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, left column bottom continuing right column top. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: In spíritu humilitátis, & in ánimo contríto suscipiámur à te Dómine: & sic fiat sacrifícium nostrum in conspéctu tuo hódie, vt pláceat tibi Dómine Deus.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column, above Veni sanctificator. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Erectus expandit manus, easque in altum porrectas iungens eleuatis ad cælum oculis, & statim demissis, dicit:

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column; Benedicit oblata, prosequendo is interleaved in red. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text:
Veni sanctificátor omnípotens ætérne Deus:
Benedicit oblata, prosequendo
& béne ✠ dic hoc sacrifícium tuo sancto nómini præparátum.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Posteà, si solemniter celebrat, benedicit incensum, dicens:

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Per intercessiónem beáti Michaëlis Archángeli stantis à dextris altáris incénsi, & ómnium electórum suórum, incénsum istud dignétur Dóminus béne ✠ dícere, & in odórem suauitátis accípere. Per Christum Dóminum nostrum. Amen.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Et accepto thuribulo à Diacono incensat oblata, modo in Rubricis generalibus præscripto, dicens:

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Incénsum istud à te benedíctum, ascéndat ad te Dómine, & descéndat super nos misericórdia tua.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Deinde incensat Altare, dicens:

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Dirigátur Dómine orátio mea, sicut incénsum, in conspéctu tuo: eleuátio mánuum meárum sacrifícium vespertínum. Pone Dómine, custódiam ori meo, & óstium circumstántiæ lábiis meis: vt non declínet cor meum in verba malítiæ, ad excusándas excusatiónes in peccátis.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Deinde reddit thuribulum Diacono, dicens:

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2.
units.text: Accéndat in nobis Dóminus ignem sui amóris, & flammam ætérnæ caritátis. Amen.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 173, right column bottom, continuing p. 174, left column top. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 2,3.
units.text: Posteà incensatur Sacerdos à Diacono, deinde alij per ordinem. Interim Sacerdos lauat manus, dicens:

units.source_locator: Printed p. 174, left column, Lavabo through doxology Amen. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 3.
units.text:
Lauábo inter innocéntes manus meas: & circumdábo altáre tuum Dómine.
Vt áudiam vocem laudis: & enárrem vniuérsa mirabília tua.
Dómine diléxi decórem domus tuæ, & locum habitatiónis glóriæ tuæ.
Ne perdas cum ímpiis ánimam meam, & cum viris sánguinum vitam meam.
In quorum mánibus iniquitátes sunt: déxtera eórum repléta est munéribus.
Ego autem in innocéntia mea ingréssus sum: rédime me, & miserére mei.
Pes meus stetit in dirécto: in ecclésiis benedícam te Dómine.
Glória Patri, & Fílio, & Spirítui sancto.
Sicut erat in princípio, & nunc & semper, & in sæcula sæculórum, Amen.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 174, left column, after Lavabo doxology and above Suscipe sancta Trinitas. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 3.
units.text:
In Missis pro defunctis, & tempore Passionis in Missis de Tempore omittitur,
Glória Patri.
Deinde aliquantum inclinatus in medio Altaris, iunctis manibus super eo, dicit:

units.source_locator: Cistercian missal 1657, printed p. 174, left bottom continuing right top column; FIDES file 0236.
units.text: Súscipe sancta Trínitas, hanc oblatiónem, quam tibi offérimus ob memóriam passiónis, resurrectiónis, & ascensiónis Iesu Christi Dómini nostri: & in honóre beátæ Maríæ semper vírginis, & beáti Ioánnis Baptístæ, & sanctórum Apostolórum Petri & Pauli, & istórum, & ómnium Sanctórum: vt illis profíciat ad honórem, nobis autem ad salútem: & illi pro nobis intercédere dignéntur in cælis, quorum memóriam ágimus in terris. Per eúmdem Christum Dóminum nostrum. Amen.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 174, right column, after Suscipe Trinitas. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 3.
units.text: Posteà osculatur Altare, & versus ad populum, extendens & iungens manus, voce paululùm eleuata dicat.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 174, right column; invitation, Minister rubric, Suscipiat response, Sacerdos rubric and Amen. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 3.
units.text:
Oráte fratres, vt meum ac vestrum sacrifícium acceptábile fiat apud Deum patrem omnipoténtem.
Minister, seu circumstantes respondent: alioquin ipsemet Sacerdos.
Suscípiat Dóminus sacrifícium de mánibus tuis (vel meis) ad laudem & glóriam nóminis sui, ad vtilitátem quoque nostram, totiúsque Ecclésiæ suæ sanctæ.
Sacerdos submissa voce dicit,
Amen.

units.source_locator: Printed p. 174, right column, Deinde manibus extensis through signum Crucis sibi producit à fronte ad pectus; above rule and ¶ Sequens Præfatio. FIDES page-files 0234–0236; controlling facsimile PDF page(s) 3.
units.text:
Deinde manibus extensis absolutè sine
Orémus,
subiungit Orationes secretas. Quibus finitis, cùm peruenerit ad conclusionem, clara voce dicit:
Per ómnia sæcula sæculórum.
cum Præfatione, vt in sequentibus. Præfatio incipitur ambabus manibus positis hinc inde super Altare: quas aliquantulùm eleuat, cùm dicit
Sursum corda.
Iungit eas ante pectus, & caput inclinat, cùm dicit;
Grátias agámus Dómino Deo nostro.
Deinde disiungit manus, & disiunctas tenet vsque ad finem Præfationis: qua finita, iterum iungit eas, & inclinatus dicit,
Sanctus.
Et cùm dicit,
Benedíctus qui venit.
signum Crucis sibi producit à fronte ad pectus.
